programs.title: Love & Other Drugs
programs.desc: In 1990s Pittsburgh, a medicine peddler starts a relationship with a young woman suffering from Parkinson's disease.

programs.title: Alice, Sweet Alice
programs.desc: In 1961, divorced Catholic couple Dom and Catherine Spages' life is upended when their teenage daughter Alice is suspected of her younger sister Karen's brutal murder during her First Holy Communion. Then a series of stabbings follow.

programs.title: Monsieur Verdoux
programs.desc: A suave but cynical man supports his family by marrying and murdering rich women for their money, but the job has some occupational hazards.

programs.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
programs.desc: Jess and Max are ready to call off their wedding due to the overwhelming stress over how out-of-control the planning and everything has become. At their wit’s end, they go to see Billie, a beautiful ‘always a bridesmaid’ kind-hearted soul who has a non-profit devoted to donating the components of already-paid-for, yet dismantled weddings, to the underserved and people with special needs. However, Max’s brother Charlie will stop at nothing to keep Jess and Max together and enlists the help of Billie by enticing her with extra help for her business.

programs.title: Forever in My Heart
programs.desc: Jenna and Charlie found love in Ireland but their dreams drove them apart. Five years later, they reunite and Jenna has to decide where her heart belongs - back home or in the Emerald Isle?
